Aufgabenstellung Der Leiter Global Regulatory Affairs CMC - Network Strategy & Operation ist verantwortlich für: Partner eng mit globalen und regionalen Global Regulatory Affairs-Kollegen sowie Global Operations Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten, um regulatorische Strategie-Herausforderungen zu bewältigen und innovative, zeitnah regulatorische CMC-Lösungen zu liefern, die den wachsenden regulatorischen und Compliance-Anforderungen entsprechen. Unterstützung der digitalen Innovation, der Aktivierung von Kapitalprojektinitiativen und der Verwaltung strategischer externer Partnerschaften durch die Koordination und Ausrichtung regulatorischer CMC-Strategien und -Aktivitäten im gesamten Unternehmen. Sicherstellung der operativen Ausrichtung von CMC-Aktivitäten und -Prozessen im Bereich Global Regulatory Affairs und im Bereich Global Operations. Diese Rolle fördert eine starke funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und effektive Kommunikation über Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs und andere relevante CSL-Geschäftsfunktionen, um die Ausrichtung und Unterstützung der strategischen Geschäftsziele der CSL zu fördern. Haupt
• Verantwortung und Rechenschaft Entwicklung globaler regulatorischer CMC-Strategien für unternehmensweite CAPEX- und Compliance-Projekte durch Zusammenarbeit mit funktionellen Führungskräften in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations und anderen Geschäftsfunktionen. Unterstützung und Erleichterung der Nutzung digitaler Innovationen für Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, einschließlich KI/ML-Anwendungen, die regulatorische Einreichungs-, Benachrichtigungs-, Bewertungs- und Aufklärungsaktivitäten verwalten oder unterstützen. Zusammenarbeit mit Beschaffung, IT, externen Anbietern und R&D Global Regulatory Affairs, um Lösungen der nächsten Generation zu implementieren, die die Erstellung von Regulierungsstrategien und die Durchführung von Regulierungsoperationen verbessern. Definition und Überwachung von Kennzahlen zur Messung der Auswirkungen digitaler Initiativen auf betriebliche Effizienzindikatoren. Verwalten Sie Beziehungen mit Outsourcing-Anbietern, um globale regulatorische CMC-Aktivitäten zu unterstützen. Betreuen Sie sich als Ansprechpartner für externe Partner, koordinieren Sie Lieferungen, Fristen und Compliance in mehreren Projekten und Geographien. Überwachen Sie Leistung, Qualität, Kennzahlen und regulatorische Bereitschaft ausgelagerter Operationen, treiben Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Risikominderungsstrategien. Überwachen, interpretieren und kommunizieren sich entwickelnde globale CMC-Verordnungen (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA usw.). Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Verbreitung von regulatorischen Informationen an interne Interessenvertreter und Integration in die strategische Planung. Koordinieren Sie wichtige regulatorische CMC-Aktivitäten für die Global Regulatory Affairs CMC-Organisation, einschließlich Änderungskontrolle, Due Diligence (für potenzielle Akquisitionen, Lizenzierung und Partnerschaften), Template-Management für Qualitäts-CTD-Abschnitte, Abweichungsunterstützung, Inspektionsunterstützung und andere. Unterstützen Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit der CSL Corporate & External Affairs Organisation, um gesetzliche und gesetzliche Initiativen zu unterstützen, damit CSL eine aktive Führungsrolle bei der Gestaltung von politischen und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen übernehmen kann, die die Entwicklung, Registrierung und das Life-Cycle-Management von plasmaerzeugten Therapien beeinflussen. Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung strategischer und taktischer Pläne für die CMC Global Regulatory Affairs, Beratung der Führungsrolle bei regulatorischen Anforderungen und deren Auswirkungen auf die Projektzeitpläne, Compliance und Geschäftsstrategie. Beitrag zur Bewertung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams. Die Gewährleistung der Regulierungspolitik und -verfahren wird entsprechend den geltenden internationalen Standards und Anforderungen entwickelt und umgesetzt. Unterstützung bei der Schaffung und Durchführung von Regulierungsrichtlinien, Prozessen und SOPs, die den globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig die operative Effizienz und Effizienz im gesamten Global Operations und seinem Stakeholder-Netzwerk steigern. Unterstützung bei der Durchführung des Outsourcings von regulatorischen Aktivitäten, einschließlich Leistungsüberwachung und Qualitätssicherung, um eine rechtzeitige und konforme Erbringung von Dienstleistungen im Einklang mit Geschäfts- und Regulierungsanforderungen sicherzustellen

Fonction Le chef des Affaires réglementaires mondiales CMC - Stratégie et fonctionnement du réseau est responsable : Collaborer étroitement avec les collègues des Affaires réglementaires mondiales et régionales, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants des Opérations mondiales, afin de relever les défis de la stratégie réglementaire et d'offrir des solutions de réglementation novatrices et opportunes qui répondent aux exigences de réglementation et de conformité en évolution. Soutenir l'innovation numérique, favoriser les initiatives de projets d'immobilisations et gérer les partenariats stratégiques externes en coordonnant et en alignant les stratégies et les activités réglementaires du MCC dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Assurer l'harmonisation opérationnelle des activités et des processus du CMC avec ceux de la R-D et des Opérations mondiales. Ce rôle favorise une solide collaboration interfonctionnelle et une communication efficace entre les Opérations mondiales, la R-D, les Affaires réglementaires mondiales et d'autres fonctions opérationnelles pertinentes de CSL afin de favoriser l'alignement et de soutenir les objectifs stratégiques de CSL. Principale
• Responsabilités et responsabilités Élaborer des stratégies de réglementation à l'échelle mondiale pour les projets CAPEX et de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise grâce à une collaboration avec des chefs de file fonctionnels dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires à l'échelle mondiale, MCC, Affaires réglementaires mondiales, R-D, Qualité, Opérations mondiales et autres fonctions commerciales. Évaluer et faciliter l'utilisation de l'innovation numérique pour les Affaires réglementaires mondiales, y compris les applications d'IA/ML qui gèrent ou appuient les activités de présentation, de notification, d'évaluation et de renseignement réglementaires. Collaborer avec Approvisionnement, TI, fournisseurs externes et R-D Affaires réglementaires mondiales pour mettre en oeuvre des solutions de nouvelle génération qui améliorent la production de stratégies réglementaires et l'exécution des opérations réglementaires. Définir et surveiller les ICR pour mesurer l'impact des initiatives numériques sur les indicateurs d'efficacité opérationnelle. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs sous-traitants pour appuyer les activités de réglementation mondiale du CMC. Servir de contact pour les partenaires externes, coordonner les produits livrables, les échéanciers et la conformité dans plusieurs projets et géographies. Surveiller le rendement, la qualité, les ICR et l'état de préparation réglementaire des opérations sous-traitées, en favorisant l'amélioration continue et les stratégies d'atténuation des risques. Surveiller, interpréter et communiquer l'évolution de la réglementation mondiale sur le MCC (ADF, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Assurer la diffusion en temps opportun des renseignements réglementaires aux intervenants internes et l'intégration à la planification stratégique. Coordonner les principales activités de réglementation du CMC pour l'organisation Affaires réglementaires mondiales du CMC, y compris le contrôle du changement, la diligence raisonnable (pour les acquisitions potentielles, les licences et les partenariats), la gestion des modèles pour les sections de qualité du CTD, le soutien aux écarts, le soutien à l'inspection, etc. Appuyer la collaboration avec l'organisation des Affaires corporatives et extérieures de la CSL afin d'appuyer les initiatives législatives et législatives afin de permettre à la CSL de jouer un rôle de leadership actif dans l'élaboration des politiques et des cadres réglementaires qui influent sur le développement, l'enregistrement et la gestion du cycle de vie des thérapies à base de plasma. Appuyer l'élaboration de plans stratégiques et tactiques pour les Affaires réglementaires mondiales MCC, conseiller les cadres supérieurs sur les exigences réglementaires et leurs répercussions sur les échéanciers, la conformité et la stratégie opérationnelle des projets. Contribuer à l'évaluation des nouvelles possibilités d'affaires en collaboration avec les équipes de développement. Veiller à ce que les politiques et procédures réglementaires soient élaborées et mises en oeuvre conformément aux normes et aux exigences internationales applicables. Appuyer la création et l'exécution de politiques, processus et SOP réglementaires qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en favorisant l'efficience et l'efficacité opérationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales et de son réseau d'intervenants. Appuyer l'exécution de l'externalisation des activités réglementaires, y compris la surveillance du rendement et l'assurance de la qualité, afin d'assurer la prestation en temps voulu et conforme des services conformément aux exigences des entreprises et de la réglementation

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Tech Ops

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile di progetto senior, Operazioni tecniche
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de projet principal, Opérations techniques

jobs.description:
Responsible for leading the successful operational execution of global, cross-functional Tech Ops projects of strategic importance to CSL’s product portfolio, ensuring delivery against defined scope, timelines, budget, and quality requirements.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Support the execution of cross-functional project plans in alignment with defined project strategy and objectives

• Translate project strategy into detailed operational plans, including scope, timelines, resource plans, and deliverables

• Drive day-to-day project management activities across global, matrixed teams to ensure timely and quality delivery

• Develop, maintain, and control project documentation, including schedules, resource forecasts, budgets, and risk registers

• Monitor project performance against plan (timeline, budget, scope) and proactively implement corrective actions where required

• Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate critical topics in a structured and timely manner

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information in project management systems, ensuring transparency and traceability of decisions, actions, and changes

• Analyze critical path, evaluate scenarios, and challenge assumptions to enhance robustness and predictability of project plans

• Prepare high-quality, concise project updates and reports for senior stakeholders

• Coordinate cross-functional alignment and ensure effective communication across stakeholders

• Support continuous improvement of project management practices, tools, and processes

• Provide informal guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced project managers or team members

Qualifications & Experience

• Required: Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Preferred: Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) or MBA

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent preferred

• 8+ years of experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry

• 3–5 years of experience managing cross-functional projects in a global, matrixed environment

• Solid understanding of drug development, manufacturing, and Tech Ops processes

• Demonstrated track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting quality expectations

• Strong problem-solving, organizational, and planning skills

• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence without authority

• Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization

• Proficient in project management tools and systems (e.g., Microsoft Project or equivalent)

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Researches and develops innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs, from early discovery through clinical trials to commercialization. It ensures that all products meet the highest clinical safety standards and comply with global regulatory requirements. The role involves analyzing complex data, managing research processes, and maintaining technical documentation and systems. It also includes designing and implementing experimental and operational processes to support efficient product development and informed decision-making. In addition, the position leads projects and cross-functional teams, overseeing portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Finally, it contributes to the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to enable efficient, scalable, and compliant production.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provides high quality scientific expertise in applying technology platforms to R&D

• Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments

• Coaches junior scientists and contributes to team development

• Manages projects/processes with limited supervision and ensures scientific rigor

• Collaborates cross-functionally to meet project milestones

• Works together with and provide expertise to other team members in order to achieve specified research project objectives within defined time parameters

Your skills and experience

• PhD preferred or Master’s degree in a relevant field

• Minimum 3 years of industry or academic experience

• Troubleshooting complex experiments

• Guiding junior staff and managing project timelines

• Aligning research with broader goals

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

jobs.title: Design & Technology Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la conception et de la technologie

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Technology & Design Lead is responsible for:

Design ownership and governance across Tier 1 capital projects ($50M+), ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Provide process technology leadership with a focus on aseptic processing. The position ensures robust process definition, system ownership, and ongoing manufacturing support for aseptic equipment operations, fostering consistency and innovation in design and technology execution globally.

Key 
• Responsibilities

Design Element

Establish and maintain appropriate engineering design standards to ensure consistency across all CapEx projects.

Develop and manage a knowledge management program to ensure all design content is available and understood globally and at site levels.

Lead conceptual and detailed design phases for Tier 1 capital projects, ensuring compliance with cGMP, FDA, EMA, and global standards.

Validate design deliverables against project scope, budget, and schedule.

Develop initial project scope, basis of design, and feasibility assessments.

Collaborate with stakeholders to define user requirements and design criteria.

Execute design assurance reviews and health checks at key project milestones.

Identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain design integrity.

Provide expert advice to site engineering teams on design standards and best practices.

Mentor site engineers and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.

Engage with external design partners and EPC firms to ensure quality and compliance.

Negotiate design-related contracts and manage vendor performance.

Implement digital design tools and BIM methodologies for efficiency.

Drive sustainability and modular design strategies in capital projects.

Process Technology

Serve as the global subject matter expert for aseptic processing technologies, ensuring best-in-class practices in project definition and system ownership.

Lead the development and implementation of process technology strategies for aseptic manufacturing, including equipment selection, process flow, and integration with facility design.

Define and own process technology requirements during project scoping, ensuring alignment with regulatory and business needs.

Oversee the specification, design, and qualification of aseptic processing systems and equipment.

Provide technical leadership and support for technology transfer, scale-up, and commissioning of aseptic processes.

Act as system owner for aseptic process technologies, maintaining lifecycle documentation and ensuring ongoing compliance.

Support manufacturing operations by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to aseptic equipment and processes.

Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to drive continuous improvement in aseptic operations.

Ensure robust training and knowledge transfer for aseptic process technologies across global sites.

Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes, adapting process technology strategies as needed to maintain competitive advantage and compliance.

Required 
• Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, or related discipline).

12+ years in engineering design and process technology for GMP-regulated facilities, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.

Proven track record in Tier 1 capital project design, assurance, and aseptic process technology leadership.

PMP or equivalent; LEED or sustainability certification preferred.

Strong knowledge of biopharma facility design, aseptic processing, clean utilities, HVAC, and process systems.

Familiarity with ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500, and risk-based design approaches.

Experience with biologics, cell & gene therapy, or sterile manufacturing facilities.

Proficiency in BIM, AutoCAD, and digital design platforms.

Global mindset and ability to work in a matrix organization

Descrizione del lavoro Posizione Sommario Il Technology & Design Lead è responsabile per: La proprietà e la governance del design nei progetti di capitale Tier 1 ($50M+), assicurando l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali, i requisiti normativi e le best practice del settore. Fornire leadership di tecnologia di processo con un focus sulla lavorazione asettica. La posizione garantisce una robusta definizione dei processi, la proprietà del sistema e un supporto continuo per le operazioni di equipaggiamento asettico, favorendo la coerenza e l'innovazione nell'esecuzione della progettazione e della tecnologia a livello globale. chiave
• Responsabilità Elemento di progettazione Stabilire e mantenere adeguati standard di progettazione ingegneristica per garantire la coerenza in tutti i progetti CapEx. Sviluppare e gestire un programma di gestione delle conoscenze per garantire che tutti i contenuti di progettazione siano disponibili e compresi a livello globale e a livello del sito. Concettuali e dettagliate fasi di progettazione per progetti di capitale Tier 1, assicurando la conformità a cGMP, FDA, EMA e standard globali. Convalida i prodotti di design contro la portata del progetto, il budget e il calendario. Sviluppare la portata iniziale del progetto, la base della progettazione e le valutazioni di fattibilità. Collabora con gli stakeholder per definire i requisiti degli utenti e i criteri di progettazione. Esegui recensioni di garanzia del design e controlli sulla salute nelle pietre miliari principali del progetto. Identificare i rischi e implementare azioni correttive per mantenere l'integrità del design. Fornire consulenza esperta ai team di ingegneria del sito sugli standard di progettazione e le migliori pratiche. Gli ingegneri del sito Mentor e promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze in team globali. Impegnarsi con partner di design esterni e aziende di EPC per garantire qualità e conformità. Negoziare contratti relativi alla progettazione e gestire le prestazioni del fornitore. Attuazione strumenti di progettazione digitale e metodologie BIM per l'efficienza. Guidare la sostenibilità e le strategie di progettazione modulare nei progetti di capitale. Tecnologia di processo Servire come esperto di materia globale per le tecnologie di elaborazione asettica, assicurando le best-in-class pratiche nella definizione del progetto e la proprietà del sistema. Condurre lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di tecnologia di processo per la produzione asettica, tra cui la selezione di attrezzature, il flusso di processo e l'integrazione con la progettazione di impianti. Definire e propri requisiti di tecnologia di processo durante la valutazione del progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con le esigenze normative e aziendali. Superare le specifiche, la progettazione e la qualificazione dei sistemi di elaborazione asettica e delle attrezzature. Fornire la leadership tecnica e il supporto per il trasferimento tecnologico, la scala e la messa in servizio dei processi asettici. Agire come proprietario di sistema per tecnologie di processo asettiche, mantenere la documentazione del ciclo di vita e garantire la conformità continua. Supporta le operazioni di produzione mediante la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione di problemi complessi relativi alle apparecchiature e ai processi asettici. Collabora con team di produzione, qualità e ingegneria per migliorare continuamente le operazioni asettiche. Assicurare una formazione robusta e un trasferimento di conoscenze per le tecnologie di processo asettiche nei siti globali. Monitorare le tendenze del settore e i cambiamenti normativi, adattare le strategie di tecnologia di processo necessarie per mantenere il vantaggio competitivo e la conformità. Obbligo
• Qualifiche Laurea o Master in Ingegneria (meccanica, elettrica, chimica, civile, o disciplina correlata). 12+ anni di progettazione ingegneristica e tecnologia di processo per strutture regolamentate GMP, con almeno 8 anni di ruoli di leadership. Provato track record in Tier 1 capitale progetto progettazione, garanzia, e asettico processo tecnologia leadership. PMP o equivalente; LEED o certificazione di sostenibilità hanno preferito. Forte conoscenza della progettazione di impianti biofarmaci, elaborazione asettica, utilità pulite, HVAC e sistemi di processo. Familiarità con ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500 e approcci di progettazione basati sui rischi. Esperienza con biologici, terapia cellulare e genica, o strutture di produzione sterili. Proficienza nelle piattaforme di progettazione BIM, AutoCAD e Digital. Mindset globale e capacità di lavorare in un'organizzazione di matrice

Identifier les risques et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour maintenir l'intégrité de la conception. Fournir des conseils d'experts aux équipes d'ingénierie du site sur les normes de conception et les pratiques exemplaires. Mentor site ingénieurs et promouvoir le partage des connaissances entre les équipes mondiales. Faire appel à des partenaires externes de conception et à des entreprises de CPE pour assurer la qualité et la conformité. Négocier des contrats liés à la conception et gérer le rendement des fournisseurs. Mettre en œuvre des outils de conception numérique et des méthodologies BIM pour l'efficacité. Favoriser la durabilité et les stratégies de conception modulaire dans les projets d'immobilisations. Technologie des procédés Servir d'expert mondial en matière de technologies de traitement aseptique, assurant les meilleures pratiques en classe dans la définition de projet et la propriété du système. Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies technologiques pour la fabrication aseptique, y compris la sélection de l'équipement, le débit des procédés et l'intégration à la conception des installations. Surveiller la spécification, la conception et la qualification des systèmes et équipements de traitement aseptique. Fournir un leadership technique et un soutien pour le transfert de technologie, l'expansion et la mise en service des processus aseptiques. Agir en tant que propriétaire de système pour les technologies de procédé aseptique, maintenir la documentation du cycle de vie et assurer la conformité continue. PMP ou équivalent; certification LEED ou de durabilité préférée. Bonne connaissance de la conception des installations biopharmaceutiques, du traitement aseptique, des services publics propres, du CVC et des systèmes de traitement. Connaissance des guides de base de l'ISPE, de l'ASTM E2500 et des approches de conception axées sur les risques. jobs.description:
Position Purpose
• Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on fractionation process and albumin.
• Apply state-of-the-art process development tool and methodologies, DoE methodologies, perform statistical data analysis.
• Support compilation of technical documents for regulatory activities.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Contribute as SME to projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of the Lab equipment, working procedure, methodologies.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Scientific and technical leadership of assigned projects in close coordination with the line manager.
• Design, planning, execution, documentation and reporting of laboratory experiments and investigations related to process improvements, process changes, alternative raw materials, and deviations on manufacturing process and/or on licensed products, with a focus on HAB, AlbuRx and fractionation.
• Contribute as SME to global RD projects / task forces and present study / investigation results.
• Onboarding, training, and guidance of laboratory staff within assigned projects.
• Regular reporting of project status to the line manager.
• Writing, reviewing and revision of SOPs.
• Archive all relevant documentation according to applicable guidelines.
• Contribute to equipment calibration and qualification according to applicable quality standards.
• Collaborate with other CSL internal departments, and external institutes and universities.
• Drive continuous improvement, innovation and modernization of Lab equipment, working procedures and methodologies.
• Comply with all safety guidelines and regulations, use safety equipment correctly, and attend safety training.
• Wear protective equipment consistently and replace when defective where prescribed and required.
• Eliminate hazards and risks immediately where possible, otherwise report them to the supervisor immediately.
• Contribute to the achievement of safety goals and actively contribute to improvements in safety and safety culture.

Education
• University of Applied Science, Bachelor, Master or PhD in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or Process Engineering (Biology, Chemistry).
Experience
• Several years (minimum 5 years) of practical experience and good knowledge in relevant fields, in particular plasma protein and purification of protein.
• Experience in process development, process improvements and manufacturing investigations.
• Experience with DoE methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Experience in laboratory documentation, reporting and SOP management.
• Experience collaborating in cross-functional and scientific environments.

Competencies
• Strong scientific and technical expertise in plasma protein purification and fractionation processes.
• Ability to design, execute and document laboratory experiments and investigations.
• Knowledge of process development tools, methodologies and statistical data analysis.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills in an international environment.
• Ability to lead projects and contribute as Subject Matter Expert (SME).
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Ability to train, guide and onboard laboratory staff.
• Continuous improvement and innovation mindset.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respirator

jobs.description:
Position Purpose
Senior Scientist with high level of experience in protein biophysics to characterize a variety of therapeutic proteins.
The incumbent applies a strong technical background in biomolecules characterization to exciting interdisciplinary projects working in a collaborative team environment on state-of-the-art instrumentations. He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities.
In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods.
Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.
• Support the transfer of qualified methods from R&D to regulated environment at the appropriate site (QC, CROs).
• Author lab procedures, protocols, reports and SOPs for internal and/or external partners.
• Present at internal and external seminars and conferences.
• Responsible for instruments operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Make effective use of resources (time, people, equipment and materials).
• Provide appropriate feedback to other team members.
• Collaborate with group members and cross functional teams to support analytical studies, process development, and other studies.
• Ensure close collaboration with other local and global CSL functions across the proper network.
Education
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in biological sciences, biophysics or analytical chemistry.

Experience
• 3+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience in the field of biomolecule characterization by chromatography and biophysical approaches.
• Experience in the development of analytical methodologies for qualitative and quantitative characterization of proteins using different biophysical and chromatographic techniques.
• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.
• Experience with various chromatography techniques (e.g. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) is considered a plus.
• Hands-on experience and knowledge in the operation and maintenance of different types of instruments (spectroscopic, LC instrumentations).
• Good understanding of scientific process, including hypothesis development and experimental design (DoE) with ability to capture and record complex scientific data accurately and reliably.
Competencies
• Strong expertise in protein biophysics and biomolecule characterization.
• Advanced knowledge of biophysical and chromatographic analytical techniques.
• Ability to design, execute and interpret complex analytical experiments.
• Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to support method developm

L'incumbent applica un forte background tecnico in biomolecole caratterizzazione a entusiasmanti progetti interdisciplinari che lavorano in un ambiente di team collaborativo sulle strumentazioni all'avanguardia. Collabora con altri scienziati e partner esterni per sviluppare saggi analitici idonei all'uso, suggerire flussi di lavoro e fornire supporto tecnico e formazione per consentire processi critici decisionali e sostenere continue attività di sviluppo della droga. In questa posizione, un elevato livello di conoscenza delle tecniche biofisiche è essenziale per fornire analisi analitiche appropriate di fase e per supportare una maggiore caratterizzazione del prodotto. Lo scienziato senior contribuirà a tradurre piattaforme innovative e nuove tecnologie in metodi completamente sviluppati e possibilmente automatizzati. L'entusiasmo scientifico, la creatività, l'esperienza di laboratorio e l'impegno saranno essenziali per il successo del team e degli obiettivi e dei tempi organizzativi. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Responsabile per la progettazione e l'esecuzione di esperimenti e per l'interpretazione dei risultati delle tecniche basate sulla biofisica e sulla cromatografia per supportare la caratterizzazione di nuovi prodotti derivati dal plasma e prodotti commercializzati.
• Sviluppo e implementazione di nuovi metodi analitici in base alla qualità analitica mediante principi di progettazione e qualifica appropriata in fase secondo le esigenze del progetto e del prodotto.
• Atto come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) per argomenti relativi alla biofisica e alla cromatografia per fornire un contributo scientifico a più progetti e per l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie.
• Sostenere il trasferimento di metodi qualificati da R&D a ambiente regolamentato presso il sito appropriato (QC, CROs).
• Procedure di laboratorio, protocolli, relazioni e SOP per partner interni e/o esterni.
• Presente a seminari e conferenze interni ed esterni.
• Responsabile per il funzionamento degli strumenti, la risoluzione dei problemi e la manutenzione.
• Utilizzare efficacemente le risorse (tempo, persone, attrezzature e materiali).
• Fornisci un feedback appropriato agli altri membri del team.
• Collaborare con i membri del gruppo e incrociare i team funzionali per sostenere gli studi analitici, lo sviluppo dei processi e altri studi.
• Assicurare una stretta collaborazione con altre funzioni CSL locali e globali in tutta la rete. Istruzione
• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in scienze biologiche, biofisica o chimica analitica. Esperienza
• 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria biofarmaceutica nel campo della caratterizzazione della biomolecola mediante cromatografia e approcci biofisici.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo di metodologie analitiche per la caratterizzazione qualitativa e quantitativa delle proteine utilizzando diverse tecniche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Esperienza teorica e pratica approfondita su diverse tecniche biofisiche (come SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) per l'analisi della struttura e della conformazione delle proteine.
• La conoscenza della caratterizzazione delle particelle sub-visibili utilizzando tecnologie come la microscopia di flusso, DLS, l'analisi di tracciamento di Nano è preferita.
• L'esperienza con varie tecniche di cromatografia (ad esempio SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) è considerata un vantaggio.
• Esperienza pratica e conoscenza nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di diversi tipi di strumenti (struzioni spettroscopiche, LC).
• Buona comprensione del processo scientifico, tra cui lo sviluppo di ipotesi e il design sperimentale (DoE) con la capacità di catturare e registrare dati scientifici complessi con precisione e affidabilità. Competenze
• Forte competenza nella biofisica delle proteine e nella caratterizzazione della biomolecola.
• Conoscenza avanzata delle tecniche analitiche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Capacità di progettare, eseguire e interpretare complessi esperimenti analitici.
• Forte capacità di risoluzione e risoluzione dei problemi scientifici.
• Capacità di supportare lo sviluppo del metodo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose Senior Scientist with high level of experience in protein biophysics to characterize a variety of therapeutic proteins. The incumbent applies a strong technical background in biomolecules characterization to exciting interdisciplinary projects working in a collaborative team environment on state-of-the-art instrumentations. He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities. In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods. Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.
• Support the transfer of qualified methods from R&D to regulated environment at the appropriate site (QC, CROs).
• Author lab procedures, protocols, reports and SOPs for internal and/or external partners.
• Present at internal and external seminars and conferences.
• Responsible for instruments operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Make effective use of resources (time, people, equipment and materials).
• Provide appropriate feedback to other team members.
• Collaborate with group members and cross functional teams to support analytical studies, process development, and other studies.
• Ensure close collaboration with other local and global CSL functions across the proper network. Education
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in biological sciences, biophysics or analytical chemistry. Experience
• 3+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience in the field of biomolecule characterization by chromatography and biophysical approaches.
• Experience in the development of analytical methodologies for qualitative and quantitative characterization of proteins using different biophysical and chromatographic techniques.
• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.
• Experience with various chromatography techniques (e.g. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) is considered a plus.
• Hands-on experience and knowledge in the operation and maintenance of different types of instruments (spectroscopic, LC instrumentations).
• Good understanding of scientific process, including hypothesis development and experimental design (DoE) with ability to capture and record complex scientific data accurately and reliably. Competencies
• Strong expertise in protein biophysics and biomolecule characterization.
• Advanced knowledge of biophysical and chromatographic analytical techniques.
• Ability to design, execute and interpret complex analytical experiments.
• Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Aufgabenstellung Senior Scientist mit hoher Erfahrung in der Proteinbiophysik, um eine Vielzahl von therapeutischen Proteinen zu charakterisieren. Der Incumbent setzt einen starken technischen Hintergrund in der Biomolekülcharakterisierung auf spannende interdisziplinäre Projekte ein, die in einem kollaborativen Teamumfeld auf hochmodernen Instrumentierungen arbeiten. Er/sie wird mit anderen Wissenschaftlern und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um geeignete analytische Assays zu entwickeln, Workflows vorzuschlagen und technische Unterstützung und Schulungen zu bieten, um kritische Prozessentscheidungen zu ermöglichen und kontinuierliche Drogenentwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen. In dieser Position ist ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen über biophysikalische Techniken unerlässlich, um phasengerechte analytische Untersuchungen zu liefern und eine verbesserte Produktcharakterisierung zu unterstützen. Der Senior Scientist wird dazu beitragen, innovative Plattformen und neue Technologien in voll entwickelte, möglicherweise automatisierte Methoden umzusetzen. Wissenschaftliche Begeisterung, Kreativität, praktische Laborerfahrung und Engagement werden für die erfolgreiche Errungenschaft von Team- und Organisationszielen und Zeitlinien unerlässlich sein. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten und Rechenschaften
• Verantwortlich für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Experimenten sowie für die Interpretation von Ergebnissen aus biophysikalischen und chromatographischen Techniken zur Unterstützung der Charakterisierung von neuem plasmaerzeugtem Produkt und kommerziellem Produkt.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer analytischer Methoden nach analytischer Qualität durch Designprinzipien und phasengerechte Qualifikation nach Projekt- und Produktanforderungen.
• Gesetz als Fachexperte (KMU) für biophysikalische und chromatographische Themen, um wissenschaftliche Beiträge zu mehreren Projekten und zur Umsetzung neuer Technologien bereitzustellen.
• Unterstützung der Übertragung von qualifizierten Methoden von FuE auf regulierte Umwelt am geeigneten Standort (QC, CROs).
• Autore Laborverfahren, Protokolle, Berichte und SOPs für interne und/oder externe Partner.
• Auf internen und externen Seminaren und Konferenzen.
• Für Gerätebetrieb, Fehlersuche und Wartung verantwortlich.
• Wirksame Nutzung von Ressourcen (Zeit, Menschen, Ausrüstung und Materialien).
• Geben Sie ein entsprechendes Feedback an andere Teammitglieder.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Gruppenmitgliedern und funktionellen Teams, um analytische Studien, Prozessentwicklung und andere Studien zu unterstützen.
• Stellen Sie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen lokalen und globalen CSL-Funktionen im richtigen Netzwerk sicher. Bildung
• Hochschulabschluss (vorzugsweise PhD) in biologischen Wissenschaften, Biophysik oder analytischer Chemie. Erfahrung
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung der biopharmazeutischen Industrie im Bereich der Biomolekülcharakterisierung durch Chromatographie und biophysikalische Ansätze.
• Erfahrungen bei der Entwicklung analytischer Methoden zur qualitativen und quantitativen Charakterisierung von Proteinen unter Verwendung verschiedener biophysikalischer und chromatographischer Techniken.
• Vertiefte theoretische und umfangreiche Hand-on-Erfahrung über verschiedene biophysikalische Techniken (z.B. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluoreszenz, FTIR) zur Analyse von Proteinstruktur und Konformation.
• Die Kenntnis der subvisiblen Partikelcharakterisierung mittels Technologien wie Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis wird bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Chromatographietechniken (z.B. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) wird als Plus betrachtet.
• Hands-on-Erfahrung und Wissen in der Bedienung und Wartung verschiedener Arten von Instrumenten (spektroskopische, LC-Instrumente).
• Gutes Verständnis des wissenschaftlichen Prozesses, einschließlich Hypothesenentwicklung und experimentellem Design (DoE) mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Daten genau und zuverlässig zu erfassen und zu erfassen. Zuständigkeiten
• Starke Expertise in der Proteinbiophysik und Biomolekülcharakterisierung.
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der biophysikalischen und chromatographischen Analysetechniken.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe analytische Experimente zu entwerfen, auszuführen und zu interpretieren.
• Starke wissenschaftliche Problemlösung und Fehlerbehebung Fähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit, Methodenentwicklung zu unterstützen

Fonction Chercheur principal ayant une grande expérience en biophysique des protéines pour caractériser une variété de protéines thérapeutiques. Le titulaire applique une solide expérience technique en caractérisation des biomolécules à des projets interdisciplinaires passionnants travaillant dans un environnement d'équipe collaborative sur des instruments de pointe. Il/elle collaborera avec d'autres scientifiques et des partenaires externes pour élaborer des analyses adaptées à l'usage, suggérer des flux de travail et fournir un soutien technique et une formation pour permettre la prise de décisions cruciales sur les processus et soutenir les activités de développement continu des médicaments. Dans cette position, un niveau élevé de connaissance des techniques biophysiques est essentiel pour fournir des analyses de phase appropriées et soutenir une caractérisation améliorée du produit. L'expert scientifique principal contribuera à la traduction de plateformes novatrices et de nouvelles technologies en méthodes entièrement développées, éventuellement automatisées. L'enthousiasme scientifique, la créativité, l'expérience pratique en laboratoire et l'engagement seront essentiels pour la réussite des objectifs et des échéances de l'équipe et de l'organisation. Principales responsabilités et responsabilités
• Responsable de la conception et de la réalisation d'expériences ainsi que de l'interprétation des résultats des techniques de biophysique et de chromatographie pour soutenir la caractérisation de nouveaux produits dérivés du plasma et de produits commercialisés.
• Mise au point et mise en oeuvre de nouvelles méthodes d'analyse en fonction de la qualité analytique par des principes de conception et une qualification adaptée aux phases selon les exigences du projet et du produit.
• Agir en tant qu'expert en matière de biophysique et de chromatographie pour apporter une contribution scientifique à plusieurs projets et à la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies.
• Appuyer le transfert de méthodes qualifiées de la R-D à l'environnement réglementé sur le site approprié (QC, ORC).
• Auteur des procédures, protocoles, rapports et PON pour les partenaires internes et/ou externes.

• Responsable du fonctionnement, du dépannage et de la maintenance des instruments.

• Collaborer avec les membres du groupe et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer les études analytiques, l'élaboration de processus et d'autres études.
• Assurer une collaboration étroite avec d'autres fonctions locales et mondiales de CSL dans tout le réseau approprié. Éducation
• Diplôme de troisième cycle (de préférence doctorat) en sciences biologiques, en biophysique ou en chimie analytique. Expérience
• 3 ans et plus d'expérience de l'industrie biopharmaceutique dans le domaine de la caractérisation des biomolécules par chromatographie et approches biophysiques.
• Expérience dans le développement de méthodologies analytiques pour la caractérisation qualitative et quantitative des protéines à l'aide de différentes techniques biophysiques et chromatographiques.
• Expérience approfondie et pratique de diverses techniques biophysiques (par exemple SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) pour l'analyse de la structure et de la conformation des protéines.
• La connaissance de la caractérisation des particules sub-visibles à l'aide de technologies telles que la microscopie par flux, la DLS, l'analyse de suivi nano est préférée.
• L'expérience de diverses techniques de chromatographie (par exemple SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) est considérée comme un plus.
• Expérience pratique et connaissances dans le fonctionnement et l'entretien de différents types d'instruments (spectroscopiques, instruments LC).
• Bonne compréhension du processus scientifique, y compris le développement d'hypothèses et la conception expérimentale (DoE) avec la capacité de capturer et d'enregistrer des données scientifiques complexes avec précision et fiabilité. Compétences
• Forte expertise en biophysique des protéines et en caractérisation des biomolécules.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Creating and leading a high-performing cross-functional team of global functional senior leaders responsible for the delivery of the product portfolio

• Creating ambitious development plans and options for each of their assets, with the goal of managing the tradeoff between time, risk, cost and value

• Accountable for the development and commercialization of development product(s) from 6-12 months prior to SG2

• Drive maximum patient value for growth brands contributing to R&D value targets through life cycle management including, label expansions, novel technologies and development of combination products, and new indications

• Asset Manager (or Member of Asset Management Forum - if relevant); responsible for global cross-TA strategy, oversight and management of product label, identification of resource synergies and allocation of license maintenance support in support of continued and maximized value generation

• Responsible for creation and execution of product strategy plan (PSP) and execution of development supporting 3-year rolling global cross-functional business plan including: Life cycle maximization, regional and emerging market value generation, maintenance of license to operate, patent defense, and real-world evidence generation

• As a member of the GPCL Leadership Network, be jointly accountable for (i) the development of cross-functional business leadership and high-performing team creation and capabilities, and (ii) talent management in Global Product Champion & Leadership

• Responsible for communicating to core PST, extended members of the PST, TALT and functional leaders in R&D and other functions as to strategic plans, challenges and needs for the products’ success

Qualifications

• Requires extensive knowledge and experience of the drug development process (15+)

• Leadership of cross-functional, multi-cultural teams in a drug development context (product or function)

• Proven track record in managing external relationships

• Proven ability to learn new information rapidly and effectively

Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). The job is in our Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Serve as CSL’s key leader in the key innovation hubs to enhance the CSL external brand leading to BD deal flow to grow our pipeline. These senior leaders will combine ecosystem engagement, strategic scouting, and deal team leadership to ensure CSL maintains a strong presence and pipeline of opportunities across biotech, academia, and investment networks. This role partners with global R&D, business development, and legal teams to strengthen the organization’s innovation pipeline and competitive advantage. The individual will leverage deep internal organizational knowledge, align with the GLG, and internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to position CSL as the partner of choice in the key ecosystems of biotech innovation. ​

Main 
• Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

· Serve as the key CSL leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, actively sourcing opportunities aligned with all TA strategies and portfolio priorities. Create new partnership opportunities for GLG presence within each ecosystem. ​
· Maintain and expand strategic relationships with universities, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and local organizations to amplify CSL’s external innovation priorities.​
· Partner closely with TA Search Leads to conduct regional searches, plan engagements and conferences, and share regional insights and updates.​
· Serve as a senior member of deal teams occurring in each region, supporting transactions from identification through due diligence and help lead relationships with external partners through deal close.​
· Organize and represent CSL at local external innovation events, such as CSL-hosted innovation days, and ensure strong visibility in the ecosystem.​
· Actively participate as a board member in key industry bodies and associations and pursue board or committee memberships to influence industry direction and strengthen networks. ​
· Maintain intimate knowledge of internal organizational capabilities, priorities, and SMEs and engage internal experts to enhance credibility and reputation externally. ​
· Provide insights on regional biotech trends, competitive landscape, and innovation hotspots. ​
· Work closely with R&D, BD, and legal teams to evaluate and integrate external assets. ​

Qualifications & Experience 
• Requirements​

· 10+ years in biopharma, external innovation, or business development with strong regional network and ecosystem knowledge.​
· Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent).​
· Proven track record of enhancing Pharma senior leadership presence/reputation as a partner of choice in biotech ecosystems to drive deal flow.​
· Proven ability to source and evaluate external opportunities and lead deal execution.​
· Strong relationship-building skills with academic, biotech, and investment communities. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

• Requisiti · 10+ anni in biofarmacia, innovazione esterna, o sviluppo aziendale con una forte rete regionale e conoscenza dell'ecosistema. · Grado avanzato richiesto (PhD, MD, o equivalente). · Provato record di traccia di migliorare la presenza di leadership senior Pharma / reputazione come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi biotech per guidare il flusso di affare. · Prova capacità di fonte e valutare le opportunità esterne e condurre l'esecuzione degli accordi. · Forte capacità di costruzione di relazioni con le comunità accademiche, biotech e di investimento. jobs.description:
Title: Senior Scientist –Bioassays
Function: Method Development, Tech Ops
Reports to: Associate Director, Method Development

Role Purpose:
The Senior Scientist responsible for the design, development, qualification, and lifecycle management of binding, enzymatic, and cell‑based assays supporting biologics and advanced therapies across discovery, development, and commercial stages.
This role provides deep technical expertise for complex bioassays, ensuring methods are fit-for-purpose, phase-appropriate and robust, while mentoring scientists and influencing cross‑functional CMC strategy.

Key Responsibilities:
Scientific & Technical Leadership:

• Lead the development and optimization of binding assays (e.g., ELISA, SPR/BLI), enzymatic assays, and cell‑based bioassays for potency, MoA, and characterization.

• Define assay strategy aligned to MoA, CQAs, and clinical phase, including selection of reference materials, controls, and acceptance criteria.

• Resolve complex assay challenges, including variability, matrix effects, specificity, drift, and biological relevance.

• Drive assay robustness, mechanistic understanding, and biological relevance, particularly for potency and functional assays.
Method Validation & Lifecycle Management:

• Author and approve Analytical Target Profiles (ATP), Method Development reports and Pre-qualification reports in alignment with ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP, and EP expectations.

• Ensure methods are phase‑appropriate and support comparability, tech transfer, and post‑approval changes.

• Provide scientific oversight for method troubleshooting, OOS/OOT investigations
Technology & Innovation:

• Evaluate and implement new assay technologies and platforms (e.g., automation, digital data capture, novel readouts).

• Champion continuous improvement in assay throughput, reproducibility, and data integrity.

• Partner with automation, data, and IT teams to modernize bioassay workflows.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

• PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Immunology, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

• Industry experience developing binding, enzymatic, and/or cell‑based assays for biologics.

• Demonstrated expertise in potency assay development and MoA‑linked bioassays.

• Strong working knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, and regulatory expectations for bioassays.

• Proven experience supporting regulatory submissions and inspections.

• Track record of scientific leadership, mentoring, and cross‑functional influence.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakehol

Titolo: Scienziato senior –Bioassays Funzione: Sviluppo del metodo, Tech Ops Rapporti a: Direttore associato, Sviluppo dei metodi Scopo del ruolo: Lo scienziato senior responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo, la qualificazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita di test vincolanti, enzimatici e basati sulle cellule che supportano la biologia e le terapie avanzate attraverso la scoperta, lo sviluppo e le fasi commerciali. Questo ruolo fornisce una profonda esperienza tecnica per i bioassay complessi, assicurando che i metodi siano adatti per gli usi, adeguati alla fase e robusti, mentre mentoring gli scienziati e influenzano la strategia CMC cross-funzionale. Responsabilità chiave: Leadership scientifica e tecnica:
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione di saggi di legame (ad esempio, ELISA, SPR/BLI), saggi enzimatici e bioassay basati sulle cellule per potenza, MoA e caratterizzazione.
• Definire la strategia di analisi allineata alla fase MoA, CQAs e clinica, inclusa la selezione di materiali di riferimento, controlli e criteri di accettazione.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di test, tra cui variabilità, effetti di matrice, specificità, deriva e rilevanza biologica.
• Guidare la robustezza, la comprensione meccanicistica e la rilevanza biologica, in particolare per la potenza e le analisi funzionali. Metodo di convalida e gestione del ciclo di vita:
• Autore e approva i profili di destinazione analitici (ATP), i rapporti di sviluppo dei metodi e le relazioni di pre-qualificazione in linea con le aspettative di ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP e EP.
• Assicurare che i metodi siano adeguati alla fase e supportano la comparabilità, il trasferimento tecnologico e le modifiche post-approvazione.
• Fornire supervisione scientifica per la risoluzione dei problemi del metodo, indagini OOS/OOT Tecnologia e innovazione:
• Valutare e implementare nuove tecnologie e piattaforme di test (ad esempio, automazione, acquisizione dati digitali, nuovi readout).
• Miglioramento continuo del campione in termini di produttività, riproducibilità e integrità dei dati.
• Collaborare con i team di automazione, dati e IT per modernizzare i flussi di lavoro di bioassay. Qualificazioni e esperienze richieste:
• PhD in Biochimica, Biologia Molecolare, Biotecnologia, Immunologia o disciplina correlata (o esperienza equivalente).
• Esperienza industriale che sviluppa test vincolanti, enzimatici e/o basati su cellule per la biologia.
• Competenza dimostrata nello sviluppo del saggio di potenza e nei bioassai collegati a MoA.
• Forte conoscenza del lavoro di ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14 e le aspettative normative per i bioassay.
• Esperienza comprovata che supporta le presentazioni e le ispezioni regolamentari.
• Tracciare il record di leadership scientifica, mentoring e influenza interfunzionale. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ . I nostri vantaggi Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL . Tu sei lungo alla CSL A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere meglio e connetterci con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere relazioni forti con il nostro palo

jobs.description:
S enior Principal Scientist, TechOps (CMC Science) – Recombinant

This role is Global and can be based in Bern, CH, Marburg DE, King od Prussia, PA USA or Kankakee IL USA

Job Purpose
The Senior Principal Scientist is a recognized technical expert within the Recombinant Integrated Product Team (IPT), providing advanced scientific expertise and leading complex technical activities to support product lifecycle management.
The role contributes to the execution of product strategies by delivering high-quality scientific input, leading defined technical initiatives, and supporting cross-functional decision-making to ensure robust product performance and continuous improvement.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities
1. Technical Expertise and Workstream Leadership

• Acts as a subject matter expert in recombinant process science, providing advanced technical knowledge to support complex product-related activities.

• Leads defined technical workstreams or projects within broader product initiatives.

• Delivers high-quality scientific outcomes in line with project objectives, timelines, and performance expectations.
2. Contribution to Product Strategy and Planning

• Contributes technical input to the development and refinement of the product technical roadmap.

• Identifies and evaluates improvement opportunities (e.g., process robustness, yield, compliance) and supports their assessment and implementation.

• Provides scientific input into business cases and supports data-driven decision-making processes.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Works within a global, matrixed IPT environment, collaborating with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, and Regulatory functions.

• Supports alignment of technical activities across sites and functions.

• Engages with stakeholders to ensure effective execution of product-related initiatives.
4. Scientific Oversight and Technical Support

• Ensures application of sound scientific principles and compliance in product lifecycle activities, including process changes and technology transfers.

• Provides input to technical decision-making processes, including change controls, validation strategies, and lifecycle management activities.

• Supports data analysis, process understanding, and technical risk assessments.
5. Continuous Improvement and Innovation

• Contributes to the identification and implementation of process improvements and efficiency gains.

• Applies scientific methodologies and data analysis to improve process consistency and product quality.

• Supports implementation of best practices and innovative approaches within the IPT.
6. Stakeholder Interaction and Communication

• Communicates complex technical information clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Contributes to technical discussions and governance forums as required.

• Builds effective working relationships to support delivery of product objectives.
7. Coaching and Knowledge Sharing

• Provides guidance and informal mentoring to junior scientists and team members.

• Contributes to knowledge sharing and continuous development of technical capabilities within the organization.

Qualifications & Experience Requirements

• PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or related Life Sciences discipline.

• Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical development and/or manufacturing within a GMP environment.

• Strong expertise in recombinant product process development, manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Experience contributing to complex technical projects in a matrix environment.

• Solid understanding of process validation, technology transfer, and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Director, Pathogen Safety
jobs.description:
The position will be accountable for establishing the Pathogens Safety (PS) strategies for the project portfolio of respective Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) such as Plasma-Derived Medicinal Products, Vaccines, Recombinants and ensuring that the pathogen safety data packages are executed in partnership with PS Laboratories and PS Support teams. You’ll be seen as a strategic thinker, a leader and influencer within Pathogen Safety and beyond. You will also be responsible for maintaining awareness of external trends such as emerging industry and regulatory best practice.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Leads the development and execution of all aspects of Pathogen Safety strategy for respective product platform including requirements for starting and raw materials, virus and prion testing strategy definition, pathogen reduction footprint over manufacturing process and adventitious agents’ contamination control strategies for manufacturing facilities.

· Accountable for delivery of end-to-end overall safety strategies for all projects under respective IPT portfolio from defining pathogen safety measures to providing high quality packages to the regulatory authorities whilst adhering to industry standards and regulatory requirements.

• Provide strategic oversight of pathogen safety measures for all projects under respective IPT including overview of emerging industry standards, regulatory framework in areas of virus and prion safety, IP evaluation and due diligence support.

• Together with PS peers co-owns and maintains Pathogen Safety best practices as well as Pathogen Safety by Design framework and its implementation within the Pathogen Safety team and IPTs.

· Responsible for leading meetings within PS to track pathogen safety work packages and resolve technical issues and scientific questions pertaining to these work packages
· Defines virus/prion reduction targets for spiking studies to be executed internally or externally

· Communicates pathogen safety strategies and respective work packages to CMC leads and IPT leads as required
· Manages execution of pathogen safety work packages through strong partnership with PS Laboratories and PS Support teams in line with project timelines under the TechOps governance.
· If applicable, designs externalization strategy for pathogen safety measures through collaboration with PS support and respective IPT capabilities in a matrix format

· Tracks delivery of pathogen safety packages against integrated IPT schedule and reports progress to IPT as required

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Education ( Minimum education required for the role. This includes degrees, licenses, and certifications that are required to perform the job.)

• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Life Sciences

• undefined
Experience ( Minimum years of experience and knowledge required to perform the job.)

• Minimum 7-10 years’ experience in a biological pharmaceutical environment

• A solid understanding of NPD and LCM in a Biopharmaceutical environment

• Proven track record in managing complex projects and strategy development

• Experience working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams
